description: What kind of step an Autark document describes, from the text an Autark node holds. Read by src/tests/utils/autkSpecKindCases.test.ts (classifyAutkSpecString) and by backend/tests/test_runs/test_autk_spec_kind.py (execution/autk_spec_kind.classify_autk_spec_string, and run_plan.node_role: a run on the server runs a data node, forwards a render node and leaves the rest to the browser).

cases.name: an OSM extract only loads
several sources only load
a key no family names changes nothing
an empty data section loads nothing, so the node reads its input
a data section that is not a list loads nothing
a map draws what the node loads
a plot draws what the node loads
a map written as an empty list is still named
a map written as false is still named
a map written as null names no map
a compute step over what the node loads computes
an empty compute list computes nothing
a compute step alone computes
an empty compute list alone is nothing
an empty document
an empty editor
an editor holding only blanks
a document cut short
a reference outside quotes holds its place until it is resolved, so the document still loads
a map whose layer takes its box's color from a chip standing on its own still draws
a plot whose sort and scale are chips standing on their own still draws
a compute step whose shader is a widget standing on its own still computes
a map that is itself a chip is still named
